Paragraph: "How will Seetha, delicate and accustomed to comfort, spend this dark night in the clutches of ruthless demons?"
Situation/Problem_Faced: Ruminating over Seetha's vulnerability and night-time suffering under captivity.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama projects protective concern and deep empathy toward his missing partner.
Outcome/Resolution: His intense worry emphasizes his commitment to her rescue.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Krupa-Chinta (Anxious, compassion-driven concern for a suffering loved one)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Demonstrates divine compassion (Krupa) where the Lord feels acute distress for the suffering of the individual soul.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Secondary trauma and cognitive rumination: worrying obsessively about a loved one's vulnerability in hostile conditions.
